## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

A PR review now stays tied to the exact commit the agent examined. If the branch advances before submission, the review is withheld rather than being attached to—and potentially approving—code the agent never reviewed; missing reviewed-head data also fails closed. [#2126](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2126)

When a Discord run fails without producing visible text, the failure reply is now posted without a preceding “(no output)” placeholder. Partial output is still delivered before the failure explanation, while the web sink retains its final output frame. [#2128](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2128)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

### Bug fixes

Agent workspace images now provide Bun and npm 12 without carrying the vulnerable npm bundled in the Node base image. The gateway runtime drops npm, npx, Yarn, and Corepack entirely; its Node entry point and BusyBox health check do not need them. The image builds verify the tool versions and that the unwanted package managers are absent. [#2121](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2121)

When a Discord run is cancelled before producing text, it now shows only the cancellation notice instead of a delayed “(no output)” reply. Partial output is still flushed, other empty runs retain their no-output notice, and web subscribers still receive the terminal output frame. [#2118](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2118)

Dashboard operators can now review and decide approvals raised by Discord-started runs. Approvals are associated with run IDs, delivered and replayed over SSE, and decisions remain scoped to the run; Discord buttons continue to use the thread, while existing repository access and authorization gates are preserved. [#2122](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2122)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

Dashboard answers and skips on Discord question cards now carry a “(dashboard)” marker, matching the existing approval cards so operators can tell where a decision came from. Discord-originated decisions still identify the user normally, and timed-out or cancelled questions remain unchanged. [#2113](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2113)

Workflow values are now passed into shell steps through environment variables instead of being interpolated into script text. This covers 26 expressions across 17 steps in six workflows, with a new check that prevents expressions from returning to `run:` bodies; workflow behavior is otherwise unchanged. [#2106](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2106)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

On credential-withheld triggers, the Action can now retain static, credential-free local MCP servers instead of removing the entire `mcp` configuration. It drops remote servers, malformed entries, and definitions containing `{file:}` or `{env:}` references—even when those appear in nested or otherwise unknown fields—and removes `mcp` when nothing safe remains. Kept servers still run as operator code, so their commands and literal environment values are not sandboxed; fork pull requests remain subject to the caller's restrictions. [#2104](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2104)

The V1 harness is rebased onto upstream OpenCode 1.19.5, with the SDK, compatibility cap, and harness version references updated to match. After that harness build was published, the integration agent and workspace image defaults were moved to its `1.19.5+harness.bf7f7dfe` build; the production workspace image continues to override the V1 default with its V2 build. [#2097](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2097) [#2100](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2100)
